Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Chinese research infographic, portrait 2160×2880 or similarly high resolution, 3:4 aspect ratio. This is one page of a four-page coherent set about Free Fire update planning. Premium editorial information design: warm white background, dark navy Chinese sans-serif typography, strong alignment, abundant margins, restrained thin rules, blue for base gameplay/OB version changes, orange for IP collaborations, teal for owned seasonal events, purple for ranked seasons. Crisp vector-like diagrams, readable large Simplified Chinese labels, no photographs, no game characters, no fake official logo, no QR codes, no made-up dates. Make hierarchy clear and content accurately spelled. This is analytical artwork, not an official promotional poster. All supplied Chinese copy is exact. Render all required content without truncation; fit using disciplined layout rather than tiny type. Source IDs in footers refer to an accompanying source sheet. Do not invent statistics or causal conclusions.
PAGE 1 OF 4.
Title: “FF 的更新节奏”
Subtitle: “2025 年案例｜四套周期，并行推进”
Top hero diagram: four clearly separated horizontal tracks with labeled cadence and purpose:
“主版本” | “全年 4 篇主补丁公告” | “基础系统、地图、战斗与操作集中调整”
“IP 联动” | “本图核实 4 次主要开场” | “火影两章、鱿鱼游戏、数码宝贝”
“排位赛季” | “BR / CS 各约两个月” | “错开一个月，月初轮流换季”
“通行证” | “约一个月” | “持续提供任务与奖励目标”
Section heading: “基础体验具体改了什么？”
Four stacked concise blue version cards, each says “公告” next to date (IMPORTANT these are announcement dates not universal launch dates):
“02/19 · OB48 公告” — “背包容量与物品重量｜地图互动点分布｜命中音效”
“05/21 · OB49 公告” — “索拉拉新地图｜缩圈与资源调整｜返场与战备”
“07/30 · OB50 公告” — “冰墙生成器｜跳伞操作｜单排返场｜武器与 HUD”
“10/29 · OB51 公告” — “战备重做｜高级复活点｜可升级军械库｜路线标记”
Small blue bracket below the dates: “公告间隔：91 天 → 70 天 → 91 天”
Bottom highlighted takeaway: “基础体验与主题活动可以同版推进”
Supporting line: “例如 OB50：火影第二章与冰墙、跳伞、返场调整出现在同一版本。”
Footnotes, readable:
“口径：主补丁用公告日；各项实际生效时间可能不同。OB48 部分内容另标 2/26。”
“赛季按近年常见节奏；地区开服时刻有差异。”
“来源：S01–S04、S12–S14、S16｜核对：2026/09/19”
Page marker “01 / 04”.

Title: “2025 全年安排 · 上半年”
Subtitle: “1—6 月｜把赛季、基础更新与活动放在一起看”
Main body a spacious 6-row monthly planning chart. Three content columns: narrow “月份”, medium “赛季节点”, wide “本月主要内容”. Use date tags to distinguish “公告” from “上线” from “活动期”. Do not create approximate bars with misleading durations. Each month row includes exactly:
January “01 月” | “01/01 · BR 新季” | orange “01/10 · 火影第一章上线” then “木叶村、九尾事件、忍术与主题复活点” then “活动窗口：01/10—02/08*”
February “02 月” | “02/01 · CS 新季” | orange “火影第一章跨 CS 换季” and blue “02/19 · OB48 公告” then “背包、交互点、音效等基础调整；同篇含 MyZone 主题” then small “部分更新配图另标 02/26”
March “03 月” | “03/01 · BR 新季” | muted “本样本未新增主补丁／主要联动开场节点”
April “04 月” | “04/01 · CS 新季” | muted “本样本未新增主补丁／主要联动开场节点”
May “05 月” | “05/01 · BR 新季” | blue “05/21 · OB49 公告／索拉拉开放” then “新地图与滑道、缩圈、资源、返场调整” then teal “探索任务衔接周年内容”
June “06 月” | “06/01 · CS 新季” | teal “06/20 · 八周年活动开启” then “无限之环、列车与 BR / CS 主题规则” then “活动窗口：06/20—07/14”
Bottom small horizontal progression with three nodes:
“1 月：IP 开场” → “5 月：地图更新” → “6 月：周年活动”
Bottom note emphasized: “新增地图也会在赛季中途开放：索拉拉距 5/1 BR 换季已过 20 天。”
Footnotes readable:
“* 火影第一章：Garena 当期公告至 2/8；IP 方后续回顾写至 2/22，保留差异。”
“赛季节点按近年常见节奏展开；未列节点不代表当月没有地区活动或热修。”
“来源：S01、S02、S05–S07、S12、S13、S15｜核对：2026/09/19”

July “07 月” | “07/01 · BR 新季” | teal “八周年延续至 07/14”; orange “07/18 · 鱿鱼游戏上线” then “红灯绿灯、玻璃桥等局内挑战”; blue “07/30 · OB50 公告” then “冰墙、跳伞、返场等基础调整”; orange “07/30 · 火影第二章上线”

Bottom highlight: “7 月同时出现：周年收尾 → 鱿鱼联动 → OB50 基础调整＋火影第二章”
Footnotes:
“主补丁标公告日；活动标正文开放日。数码宝贝虽在 12/2 发新闻，实际 11/17 开场。”

Title: “联动是否专门放在赛季末？”
Subtitle: “2025 样本检验｜同一天，在 BR 与 CS 中处于不同阶段”
Top decisive statement in large typography:
“4 次主要联动开场”
“都在 BR 前半程，也都在 CS 后半程”
Center comparative table, ample spacing, four rows and four columns exactly:
Headers “联动开场” | “日期” | “BR 赛季位置” | “CS 赛季位置”
“火影第一章” | “01/10” | “第 10 天 · 前半程” | “第 41 天 · 后半程”

“火影第二章” | “07/30” | “第 30 天 · 前半程” | “第 60 天 · 临近换季”
“数码宝贝” | “11/17” | “第 17 天 · 前半程” | “第 48 天 · 后半程”
Use small horizontal 2-month progress marks alongside day positions, colored purple, but text must be explicit. Avoid pretending seasons are exactly 60 days; no 60-day total label. Season day numbering starts at 1.
Then three numbered analytical blocks:
“01  ‘赛季末做联动’：对 CS 有部分支持”
“本年四次开场集中在 CS 后半程；对 BR 则相反。火影两章还跨越了 CS 换季。”
